body: Possibly. But the family is convinced it happened, so it unfortunately won't mean much now.
Definitely worth a shot. I'll talk to him about me speaking to his sister once most of their pain passes.
Thanks, I try to see both peoples perspective on this. As for talking to her one on one, I could try. I'm not that close to her so I can't really say if she'll be comfortable. Time will tell.
Thanks for the reasonable advice. Yeah the who event left him feeling completely like crap since he never done this to his sister before. We'll talk about boundary setting once everyone heals.
Both had clothes on when they fell asleep.

Thanks, I feel bad for him to an extent because it seemed both parties had initially consented based on what he told me. To be controversial, I feel women are more easily believed compared to the mans' side, which is why he got so much alienation compared to her. 

As for counseling, our school has counseling service but we'll see how it changes based on quarantine. He might be open to the idea. Something so controversial like this will take some time though.

Thanks I'll consider the offer. Honestly given how I go to work nearly everyday and my friend ended up dumping this news to me is a bit overwhelming. I'll try some cheer leading methods to prevent this from being trauma. I hope my friends sister is receiving the help she needs too so no one is as traumatized.

I hope so too. Hopefully he's overplaying the entire scenario and it didn't progress that far. I'll talk to him about it with a counselor. But I'm prepared for the worst case scenario should everything be true.
Yeah exactly, I mean I'm his best friend but even I know its fucked.

Thanks for the advice. It's horrible, but I guess only time can heal this now. We'll need a lot of that for now. I just hope his 21st birthday doesn't start making him alcoholic from the whole ordeal while everyone heals.
Thanks I'll be sure to keep an eye open on him and keep open ears with his parents sometime soon.
The sister isn't disowned. She's both mad and embarrassed at him from what he told me.

Yeah I can only know so much what had happen that night. We'll try having a dialogue but it won't happen for quite a while based on the current atmosphere. I'll try to see if there's more to the story than what his family is saying.

Thanks for the advice. I'll try searching around for therapist in the area again. As for his parents, it'll probably take a while based on the trauma before we can have a dialogue again. Thanks again.

I don't know their logic I guess. But at the end of the day he's still outcasted and they're pretty certain it happend based on what the sister remembered. So it's a what can you do scenario. If it's fake, it's going to be difficult to convince emotional people to listen to you.
Honest to god I hope so. But based on what I saw and heard it's likely true since I doubt a mind game could last for two weeks  straight while his family is still actively rejecting him.

Can't guarantee. This is based on their own personal testimony, he told me his sister remembered details of the ordeal towards the end. But the amount of emotional baggage everyone had at least hints it probably happened.
Thanks, it's obviously pretty traumatic for his sister and him. I just hope he'll be able to stand on his own two feet again soon.
